name: get_ga4_channel_acquisition
title: Get Google Analytics Channel Acquisition
description: Retrieve session acquisition by channel, source/medium or campaign with selected native metrics. This differs from first-user acquisition and event-scoped attribution.

traffic_scope.description: google_organic fixes sessionSource=google AND sessionMedium=organic; organic_search fixes sessionDefaultChannelGroup=Organic Search; all adds no traffic filter. Other caller dimension filters are ANDed; filters on reserved source fields are rejected.
